digest.component_or_area: plan review caching and prompt structure
propositions: Pass-1 and both verifier prompts must begin with a byte-identical shared prefix containing the full plan material to enable within-pass and cross-run Anthropic cache reuse of the plan-bearing preamble

The reviewing stance and exhaustiveness directive must be single-sourced in prompts.py as SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE (not duplicated across templates or passes._SHARED_PREAMBLE) to enforce structural invariance and prevent drift
The finder warm-gate cache floor check must measure the actual shared prefix bytes sent (via _prefix_tokens) rather than the plan alone to correctly gate when prefix size >= 4096 tokens
Per-run finding listings must remain in the user-turn instructions output and never appear in the stable system prompt segment for both verifiers
plan-review-verifier (both agentic and single-turn variants) must be restructured to receive {{shared_prefix}} and eliminate the volatile marker since the entire system prompt is now stable
plan_review_verify_inputs must emit shared_prefix and drop the plan output; corresponding yaml with: blocks and the output schema must be rewired to reference shared_prefix instead of plan
